limitations: Original FreeRTOS list, tick, context-selection, port timer, run-time counter, stack/task initialization, ready-list insertion, critical-section and static-creation bodies execute in an emulator over authored kernel state, TCBs, stacks and supplied mtime/claim values; no hardware timer or interrupt is delivered and mret is not executed.
memset, configASSERT, the critical-section diagnostic body, vTaskDelete, the stack-overflow hook and the ecall yield wrapper are supplied. Assert, task_delete and yield stops are harness stops.

Andes CSR 0x7c6/0x7c7 are interpreted as hardware stack-protection control and bound from the documented AndeStar V5 CSR numbering; the timer frequency, hook behavior, dynamic allocation, deletion, blocking APIs and live multi-task scheduling remain unproved.
